overall_cpt_analysis.summary: Overall CPT quality is poor. While all assessed node CPTs are structurally valid, most nodes have weak parameter accuracy relative to ground truth. Four nodes are rated poor, two are fair, one is excellent, and none are good or invalid. The strongest problems come from widespread severe parameter errors in Deviation_in_Dispatch, Deviation_in_Response, and Root_Causes, which outweigh the single excellent result for Program_Anomaly.
main_reasons: Most node-level verdicts are poor: 4 of 7 assessed nodes.
Two additional nodes are only fair, so 6 of 7 nodes fall below good quality.
Deviation_in_Dispatch and Deviation_in_Response show very high mean errors and many severe parameter mismatches.
Root_Causes also has substantial inaccuracy, with a majority of parameters severely wrong.
Only Program_Anomaly is excellent, which is not enough to offset the broader pattern of poor CPT accuracy.
No assessed nodes are invalid in structure, so the main issue is parameter misestimation rather than CPT format.
